additionalParameters.description: Additional parameters that modify the authentication flow. Depends on selected IdP. See developer documentation for details.

tags.description:
A set of support optional tags to group and filter webhooks.
The maximum length for each tag is 100.

returnUrl.description: If specified the embedded view will return to this URL after authentication is completed (successfully or not). If not specified, a success or error screen will be shown inside the embedded view.

embeddedParentDomains.description: Specify the parent domains that will embed the authentication. This will be used for content security frame ancestor header if set, as an extra security mechanism to protect against clickjacking.

allowedProviders.description:
A list of Identity Providers (IdPs) that can be used for authentication.
If not specified, the end-user will be able to choose from all IdPs associated with your Signicat account.
The maximum length for each Provider is 30.

language.description:
The desired language for the UI. Expected format ISO 639-1.
If the requested language is not available, it will automatically default to English (en).
Some IdPs may have a different fallback language due to regional considerations.

flow.description: The selected flow used for this specific authentication session. To learn more about using the ```headless``` flow with Swedish BankID, please refer to this example. If flow is set to Redirect the field CallbackUrls is required.

themeId.description:
The themeId you want to use for this specific authentication session.
If not specified, the default theme for your account will be used.

requestedAttributes.description: The attributes you wish to get back from the authentication of the end-user. To find a list of which attributes can be requested, please see documentation for that specific ID method which can be found on https://developer.signicat.com/identity-methods/. Defaults to empty.

externalReference.description: An external reference for you, will be returned as a URL parameter on callbackUrls.

usageReference.description: An usage external reference for you to group your billing.

sessionLifetime.description:
Lifetime of session in seconds (Default is 1200 seconds). It has a soft-minimum value of 300 seconds, which means if the value set is
less then 300, it will be automatically set to 300 seconds.

requestDomain.description:
This specifies the domain you want to use for this specific session.
The domain will be visible in the end-user's browser.
This domain needs to be correctly configured on your account!

success.description:
Specifies the URL to redirect in case of success.
If it is not a sandbox request needs to be https.

abort.description:
Specifies the URL to redirect in case of abortion.
If it is not a sandbox request needs to be https.

error.description:
Specifies the URL to redirect in case of error.
If it is not a sandbox request needs to be https.

CallbackUrls.description: Specifies the different urls to callback to.

kty.description: Key type of the JWK, specifying the cryptographic algorithm family used with the key.

use.description: Identifies the intended use of the key. Values defined by this specification are sig (signature) and enc (encryption).

kid.description: Identifier of the key, serves as a unique identifier for the key.

alg.description:
Identifies the cryptographic algorithm family used with the key.
If kty is set to RSA needs to be RSA-OAEP.
If kty is set to EC needs to be ECDH-ES.

e.description:
The public exponent.
Required if the Kty is RSA.

n.description:
The modulus, a component that is used in both the encryption and decryption process.
Required if the Kty is RSA.

crv.description:
Identifies the cryptographic curve used with the key.
Required if the Kty is EC.

x.description:
Contains the x coordinate for the elliptic curve point.
Required if the Kty is EC.

y.description:
Contains the Y coordinate for the elliptic curve point.
Required if the Kty is EC.

d.description:
Contains the private exponent parameter.
This needs to be null.

nin.description: The National Identity Number of the prefilled input.

mobile.description: The mobile number of the prefilled input.

email.description: The email of the prefilled input.

userName.description: The user name of the prefilled input.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the prefilled input.

firstName.description: The first name of the prefilled input.

lastName.description: The last name of the prefilled input.

bankAccountNumber.description: The bank account number of the prefilled input.

organisation.description: The organisation of the prefilled input.

PrefilledInput.description: The session's prefilled input information (it is required at least one value).
